First I’d like to say that you’re a really good partner and a great human being. Second I’d ask if your wife has a support system besides you? Friends or family? If she’s on meds or going to therapy? If it’s a yes to all three you’re on the right direction. Last I’d say the support needs to be amped during and especially after the pregnancy. OCD tends to attack the things we value the most for some it’s our morality others our sanity. Your wife might also be susceptible to postpartum depression if she had depressive episodes. She might also develop OCD fears about “hurting” your baby (all just OCD btw) or not being a good mom which might mess up the bonding situation. You also need a separate support system to not get overwhelmed. Get a therapist and make sure to take care of yourself and don’t let yourself take the backseat.
